sentences.en: The accident was a strong argument for new safety measures.
sentences.zh: 这次事故是采取新安全措施的强大论据。

sentences.en: You should take the appropriate measures at the appropriate time.
sentences.zh: 你应该在适当的时候采取适当的措施。

sentences.en: You will ruin your health if you drink without measure.
sentences.zh: 如果你饮酒无度，会毁了你的健康。
